quality_contract: Every draft judged against the same English, meaning-to-preserve checks and established French technical terminology.
Candidate may be recommended as an editing aid only when the reviewer confirms intelligible French and no material omission, addition, unit, scope, authority change or implied new acceptance.

Mechanical gate must recover exact registered French terms and quantities, reject missing, duplicate or alien tokens and source-byte mismatch, and state draft review only. Correct placeholders do not imply correct semantic relations.
Any technical pass paired with material semantic failure remains a hold. No selection by fluency or release novelty alone.
measurement: Report useful and unsafe outputs separately by paired case and cohort.

Record model bytes, download/setup and inference wall and tokens, distinct external charges and observable costs, and reviewer scope. Unknown human time, electricity, maintenance and realized value stay unknown.
No economic or inventive superiority without causal improvement to matched complete outcomes and attributable costs. Keep the fastest safe productive alternative.
runtime_boundary: No model API or purchase, synthetic authorization, external publication or account changes. Run included-code construction and local inference on public source only.
